title: Decide: accept the provisional Mac-only placement or run the equivalent placement campaign
goal: The owner either accepts the provisional F-006-T12 recommendation (Mac-only P1 default) or authorizes the live runs that would make it supported
acceptance: The owner's decision is recorded in the F-006 record with its date

If the runs are authorized, they become their own agent steps with estimates before any model call: P2/P3 role-run and neutral-smoke under limits-repeat3; combination-v1 coder-alone vs coder-reviewer for mac-only and mac-coder-mini-auditor under one totalBudget; bounded live disconnected-auditor, cancellation and uncertain-outcome checks
If accepted as provisional, F-006 can close on its existing Check with the report's unknowns left recorded as unknown
privacy: A decision only; no model call, device or service change.
validation: The decision and date are in the record
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-23 (F-006-T12): one owner decision on the report's three missing-evidence items. Owner decision 2026-11-23/24: authorized the live equivalent placement runs (not the provisional acceptance), including stopping NERV on NERV-02 for the disconnected-auditor check; NERV-01's live service is never stopped or edited. The runs became F-006-T23 to F-006-T26. No actual: owner time not measured.
